authorizationBasis: User instruction to execute plans/ala-workshop-publication-plan.md end to end (session goal set 2026-10-09). This amendment exercises the plan P0 clause permitting a prospective additional allowance covered by the instruction to execute the plan. It is not a historical-budget reset and creates no retroactive authorization.
collectionGate: Collection remains disabled until ALL hold: (a) this amendment committed; (b) P3 protocols/ala-lv-study.v1.json and protocols/ala-lv-analysis.v1.json frozen and committed; (c) P4 qualification passed on the exact execution source; (d) P5 admission reservation fits inside the additional allowance below. Code, paper-preparation, and protocol work proceed before collection.
exploratoryPurpose: ALA-LV is a small prospective exploratory estimation study for one ALA workshop paper: does a learner's contemporaneous token-association record predict its receiver actions better than a validation-selected ordinary predictor, and when does that prediction track causally effective communication? Estimation-only; no LV01 family support/power labels.
